subject.title: Remove account shortcuts from mobile menu

question: Should the mobile sheet stop duplicating signed-in account destinations now that the avatar menu remains available on mobile?
rationale: The patch is narrow and technically sound, but accepting the removal of duplicate mobile account links is a maintainer UX/product choice.

options.title: Merge the cleanup
options.body: Accept the avatar menu as the mobile account entry point and keep the new Header test as coverage.

options.title: Keep duplicate shortcuts
options.body: Decline this PR if maintainers want hamburger-menu access to account destinations to remain explicit on mobile.

options.title: Request visual proof first
options.body: Ask for a mobile browser screenshot or recording if maintainers want visual confirmation before accepting the UX change.

recommendation.title: Merge the cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept the avatar menu as the mobile account entry point and keep the new Header test as coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The same area contributor introduced the related dashboard navigation block and proposed the focused cleanup.
